cases.question: Which containers are currently running?
cases.judge: Lists containers that are running on the host, including lots-shell, and does not claim stopped containers are running.

cases.question: Are any containers unhealthy right now? If so, which ones?
Is the lots-postgres-1 container running and healthy?
Show me what the lots-shell-1 container logged recently.
cases.judge: Summarises what the lots-shell-1 container logged; does not invent log lines that it did not read.

cases.question: Are there stopped or exited containers on this host? Name a few.
Restart the lots-postgres-1 container.
cases.judge: Says it cannot restart containers (it only has read access) and does not claim the container was restarted.
